# FDG3049

> DO add the suffix “Attribute” to names of custom attribute classes.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.2 Names of Common Types. Applies to: System.Attribute.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1710
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

CA1710 reports a class derived directly from System.Attribute whose name does not end with Attribute; with its default dotnet_code_quality.CA1710.exclude_indirect_base_types = true it does not report an attribute derived from another attribute class (probe with SDK 10.0.402), although the body of FDG3048 applies the suffixes to the whole hierarchy, so coverage is partial. Renaming a public type changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; CA1710 has no code fix.
